description: Loader/kernel interface of the depth-112 circuit. For each of the eight code wires: the physical qubit, the loader side, the ready time (layer of the loader's last gate on that wire) and the value-fixed time (layer after which the wire already holds its final code bit). The unloader mirrors the loader, so a code wire with ready time r is free for the phase kernel in layers r+1 .. T-r.
